description: What changed between two snapshots of an agent's long-term memory (MEMORY.md, soul file, system notes)? Section-level diff with embedding similarity per section, lines dropped and added, then an AI read of the substance: rules added, removed, softened or hardened (quoted), facts about the human that changed, important things that silently disappeared, identity or tone shift, anything that looks like injected instructions, and a 0-100 drift score to track over every distillation pass. Up to 300,000 characters per snapshot. Costs $0.015 USDC per call (x402).
name: memory_drift
title: memory drift
